Portion of MF6 - Estanzia Subd., Kaakbay Village, Goldcrest Subd, Octagon Village, Marapara Heights, Montebello Subd, Puroks  (Pinetree, Bayabasan, Mainuswagon, Marapara, Mahimayaon, Magbinuligay, Kamunsil, Tunay, Sawmill, Riverside-Bata, Andan, Simboryo, Sta. Restored at 6:29 PM
Our dedicated team has successfully restored power to the affected areas.
We sincerely thank our valued consumers for your patience and continued support throughout the restoration process.
If you are still experiencing a power outage, kindly send us your account details and contact number so we can assist you as soon as possible.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: SEPTEMBER 6, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa September 6, 2026 (Sunday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: September 6, 2026 (Sunday)
Reason: 
● Mt. View Substation Preventive Maintenance Service; Old Relay Isolation;
● 69kV Pole(2) replacement along Buri Rd near Villa Estanzia & Magdalene Ville;
● Primary pole replacement along GM Cordova, Buri and Lacson Sts. (6 Double-Circuit Poles) MF1, MF3 & MF5.;
● Primary pole (4) relocation from Citadines to North Tourist-Inn; and
● Massive Tree Clearing along Aguinaldo St.
